22200 -> 22092, and the whole move is the rebase changing the base, not the branch changing its contribution.

The 22200 was banked against the pre-rebase merge-base 801a6773577. That base no longer
exists on this branch: the 9 commits are now replayed onto origin/19.0-marin at 39f1a538d8b.
Re-measured with the CI command, `npx eslint . --format=json` summed over `errorCount`, in two
detached worktrees with node_modules symlinked and nothing uncommitted in either:

    origin/19.0-marin, no branch work   22157
    the same 9 commits replayed on it   22092

So the branch still contributes exactly -65, the same figure the superseded note attributed
across the core, ui, components, fields and webclient work. What moved is the floor beneath it:
origin had already absorbed part of the 22279 the old note started from. Banking the measured
22092 rather than carrying 22200 forward, because the gate is `exact` and an improvement fails
the build the same way a regression does.

web_hierarchy hierarchy_view.test.js is still deliberately excluded from the 65 and still reads
114 before and after.
